phrase.en: Sorry, I'm late! There was so much traffic.
phrase.ru: Прости, я опоздал! Было столько пробок.

text.ru: Извинение — Sorry I'm late или Sorry for being late (for + -ing). Причина — There was / is a lot of traffic: traffic неисчисляемое.
text.en: To apologise, say Sorry I'm late or Sorry for being late (for + -ing). Traffic is uncountable: a lot of traffic.
text.es: Disculpa: Sorry I'm late / Sorry for being late. Traffic es incontable.

exercises.en: Sorry, there was a lot of ___ on the road.
exercises.ru: Прости, на дороге было много машин.

exercises.en: Sorry, I arrived late because of the traffic.
